summary: Keep unauthenticated MCP HTTP listeners loopback-only by default and locally validate geolocation only for workflows whose API calls require it.
reason: A wildcard listener exposes credential-backed tools to network peers, while location-dependent MovieGlu requests need a deterministic local configuration error without blocking endpoints whose contracts omit geolocation.
validated_outcome: Regression tests pin the loopback listener and local missing-geolocation error; the purchase-confirmation example uses the API's HH:MM time contract.
